M41A.description: Perfect for shootin' down them xenos.
M41A.name: M41A

TYPE 88.description: A Hwanmokian produced AK74 variant. Comes with a specialty overfolder stock, and absurdly large helical magazine. Extremely poor ergonomics plague this firearm.
TYPE 88.name: TYPE 88

AKM.description: Modernized version of the AK47 rifle with various improvements to handling and functionality. Slightly reduced damage compared to the AK47 with a preference for recoil control.
AKM.name: AKM

COLT ACR.description:
The M16A2E2 ACR was an entry in the original ACR program of 1982 - characterized by the distinct handguard, ambidextrous fire controls, and the use of duplex ammunition.

While the ACR program was ultimately a dud, many of the ACR upgrades went on to see use in other guns.

Low rate of fire and dubious accuracy at range - but high damage through the duplex projectiles.

Model submitted by Rialag
COLT ACR.name: COLT ACR

TAR-21.description: Eretz-Kedem bullpup assault rifle chambered in standard 5.56x45 NATO. Features a long barrel for great ballistics over range.
TAR-21.name: TAR-21

M16A1.description: One of the most iconic weapons from the Kimlan War era which replaced the M14 battle rifle, known for being incredibly light when fully loaded. This rifle uses the early M193 cartridge, meaning its performance differs from modern M855 with poorer penetration and high velocities, but the powder used means recoil and cyclic rate is high.
M16A1.name: M16A1

attachmentModifiers.info: A more modernized version of the M16 stock, first used on the A2 version of the rifle. Improves recoil control somewhat, but also reduces overall handling somewhat.

An experimental heavy barrel and bipod for the XM16E1, allowing for excellent sustained fire & recoil control. Never adopted at scale.

Reduces rate of fire while dramatically improving recoil and damage multipliers.

AN-94.description:
A complex Zarovian assault rifle featuring a unique pulley-driven burst system. Fires two shots in the exact same place before recoil is felt.

Community submitted remodel.
AN-94.name: AN-94

AUG A2.description:
A Nomenslandian variant of the UAR, it is a successor to the F90 marketed for export featuring a redesigned receiver and is compatible with STANAG magazines.
Offers decently high fire rate with good overall damage and a decent weight.

Model submitted by Rialag.
AUG A2.name: AUG A2

HK416.description:
An Eisenmark's depiction of the AR-15 rifle, fitted with a much more robust gas system allowing use in harsher conditions. Greatly renowned for use by Grand Federation Elite Forces.
Fast firerate with average damage and controllable recoil with decent range performance.

Model submitted by Rialag.
HK416.name: HK416

AK74.description: A revision of the Kalashnikov system to accept the less powerful 5.45x39mm cartridge, improving weapon handling and accuracy.
AK74.name: AK74

L85A2.description:
A Soveran bullpup assault rifle as part of the SA80 family!
The A2 variant improved numerous issues and poor quality that plagued on the A1 variant and has remained the standard Soveran service rifle until the recent introduction of the L85A3.
Average fire rate with high overall damage, has jumpy recoil and is heavier than most assault rifles.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X.
L85A2.name: L85A2

M231.description:
The M231 Firing Port Weapon is only intended to be used inside the Bradley AFV in a special mount. Hits hard, but good luck hitting anything...
... You're going to use it anyways, Boss?
M231.name: M231

attachmentModifiers.info:
A heavy buffer tube with a nested spring used in some early XM231 prototypes - dropping the rate of fire to only 200 rounds per minute.

Why would you use this? Why would you want to use this?

G38.description:
A much more modern variant of the M416 seen in use by Federal Defense of Eisenmark, featuring ambidextrous controls with much slimmer profile.
Provides much more barrel length variety with long range focus while being faster than its original counterpart, in exchange for less-manageable recoil.

Model submitted by Rialag.
G38.name: G38

G36.description: A modern modular Eisenmark assault rifle. Originally issued with a special optics package. Middle-of-the-road rifle with a preference for ranged performance.
G36.name: G36

HOWA TYPE 20.description:
A new Tetsujin assault rifle planned to replace the Type 89 which is currently in service.
All around average performance in close and longer ranges. Below average firerate but features a lot of customisability.
HOWA TYPE 20.name: HOWA TYPE 20
